steps.title: What is a pin?
steps.body: A pin stops a piece from moving, because moving it would expose a more valuable piece behind it.

steps.title: The pinned knight
steps.body: The rook on e1 pins the knight on e7 to the king on e8. If the knight moves, the rook gives check.

steps.title: Use the pin
steps.body: The knight is pinned. Capture it with the rook.
steps.hint: The rook slides up the e-file to the knight.
steps.success: The pinned piece is gone. Good work.

steps.question: Why can the knight on e7 not move?
options: It would expose the king to the rook
steps.explanation: The king is behind the knight on the same file, so moving the knight would let the rook attack it.
